variants.drift_12_1: reference: current screen score (skips the latest month)
variants.drift_12_0: drift over the full 12 months including the latest month
variants.drift_12_1_above_ma50: drift 12-1, but stocks above their 50-day average rank ahead of all others
variants.drift_12_1_above_ma200: drift 12-1, but stocks above their 200-day average rank ahead of all others
variants.drift_12_0_above_ma50: drift 12-0, stocks above their 50-day average first

diagnostic: within the top fifth by drift_12_1, next-month return of stocks above vs below their 50-day average, against the universe
note: US index union only. Variants fixed before running; all are reported. Gated variants put every stock above the average ahead of every stock below it, so their top fifth is the strongest drift among stocks in an uptrend.
